style: instrumental cinematic comedy cue that turns grave, 100 bpm. Small pit band: plucked pizzicato violins and cello with a reedy bassoon on a lopsided, staggering little march, tipsy oom-pah lilt, playful. The march tune then piles up in clashing keys at once, bitonal, crowded and dizzy. A rising slide whistle ends in one dry woodblock snap. A single deep timpani thud. Sudden hush: one muted flugelhorn holds a long lonely note, rubato, slowing, sparse and solemn, a soft cinematic car horn far away in the distance. Acoustic orchestra, close dry mix
